Phantasmal Flames

Released November 14, 2025 · 130 cards

StandardExpanded

Phantasmal Flames is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on November 14, 2025. Its main set has 94 cards, plus 36 secret rares numbered beyond the set (130 in total). It includes 110 Pokémon, 19 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

78 illustrators worked on Phantasmal Flames. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (14), Studio Bora Inc. (4), Toyste Beach (4), takuyoa (3), Uninori (3), akagi (2), Anesaki Dynamic (2), AYUMI ODASHIMA (2).
